annotations.title: Find a Hebrew or Greek word

description: Finds Hebrew and Greek words (Strong's entries) from an English word, a transliteration ('shalom', 'agape') or the original word. Returns the best matches first (10 by default, up to 25), each with its Strong's id, lemma, definition, occurrence count and link; 'more' says how many further matches exist. Use when the user asks which Hebrew or Greek word lies behind an English word or transliteration.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-25, default 10)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

query.description: an English word, a transliteration (shalom, agape) or the Hebrew or Greek word itself

name: search_words
title: Find a Hebrew or Greek word
